notes.title: 〚 0.8.9 〛Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes V0.8.9[/h2]  

[h3]🛠 Bug Fixes[/h3]  
[*] Fixed [b]Achievement unlock[/b] issue for characters.  
[*] Fixed [b]sound stacking[/b] issues.  
[*] Fixed abnormally high spawn chances for [b]Meditate, War Cry, and Last Stand[/b].  

[h3]✨ Improvements[/h3]  
[*] Increased [b]revive chance[/b] significantly in Multiplayer mode.  
[*] Improved [b]drop rates[/b] from breakable objects.  
[*] Improved [b]hitbox accuracy[/b] for certain projectiles.  

[h3]⚔ Character Buffs & Adjustments[/h3]  

[b]Shara (Archer)[/b]  
[*] [b]Luster Burst Revamp[/b]  
[*] Luster Burst projectile speed multiplier [b]2x → 1.35x[/b]  
[*] Ammo [b]7 → 12[/b]  
[*] Projectile speed [b]20 → 22[/b]  
[*] Evo 1 Pierce Chance [b]10% → 15%[/b]  
[*] Evo 3 Pierce Chance [b]20% → 30%[/b]  
[*] Artemis Burst base damage [b]10 → 15[/b]  

[b]Theo (Miner)[/b]  
[*] Attack Speed [b]0.8 → 1[/b]  
[*] Groundbreaker base damage [b]10 → 20[/b]  
[*] Groundbreaker cooldown [b]5s → 3s[/b]  

[b]Zane (Knight)[/b]  
[*] Neo Sword Slash combo requirement reduced from [b]5 → 4[/b] to activate Super Slash.
[*] Attack Speed [b]0.7 → 0.8[/b]  
[*] Attack Target [b]5 → 6[/b]  

[b]Zenova (Star Wanderer)[/b]  
[*] Attack Speed [b]1 → 1.25[/b]  
[*] Movement Speed [b]2.6 → 2.8[/b]  
[*] Critical Chance [b]1% → 5%[/b]  

[h3]⚖ Special Upgrades[/h3]  
[*] [b]Assassination[/b] Damage [b]1000% → 1500%[/b], Cooldown [b]5s → 3s[/b]  
[*] [b]First Aid[/b] Cooldown [b]20s → 15s[/b]  

[h3]🗺 Stage Adjustments[/h3]  
[*] [b]Stage 1 Boss (Goblin King)[/b]: Damage nerfed.  
[*] [b]Stage 2 Boss (Minotaur)[/b]: Damage buffed.  
[*] [b]Stage 3 Boss (Hydra)[/b]: Damage buffed & adjusted slow effect.  

[h3]⚖ Balance Changes[/h3]  
[*] Rebalanced [b]all boss damage[/b] for better gameplay fairness.  
[*] Adjusted [b]Ice Spike slow effect[/b] on Stage 3.  
[*] Buffed [b]Berserker's Blood[/b]: Damage reduction [b]-25% → -15%[/b].  
[*] Buffed [b]Double Edge[/b]: Damage reduction [b]-30% → -20%[/b].  
[*] Buffed [b]Damage upgrades[/b]: Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic values [b]2/4/6/9 → 3/5/7/10[/b].  
[*] Buffed [b]Uncommon HP & Stamina upgrades[/b]: Increased [b]10 → 15[/b].  
[*] Buffed [b]Rare Skill Amp upgrade[/b]: Increased [b]10% → 15%[/b].  
[*] Adjusted stat weighting: Reduced [b]Critical Damage & Stamina[/b] weight, increasing the chance for [b]Damage & Attack Speed[/b] upgrades.

notes.title: Ver.0.8.8 Celestial Awakening Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44461284/024aac2132550ff21c1d078715d474120c51f5e7.jpg[/img]

New Character Unlocked: 
[h2][b]Wu Ran the Celestial[/b][/h2]

Innate Ability: [b]Sky Yin Sword[/b]
Mark attacked enemy, upon attacking marked enemy summon Thunderbolt that deal damage in area

Weapon Evo: [b]Heavenly Yang Sword[/b]
Summon rotating sword around player, when break launch a homing Heavenly Soaring Sword

[h3][b]Other Changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]New Special Upgrade [b]War Cry[/b] : Knockback enemies and damage them. Increase player Damage and Damage Resistance for 5s. Cooldown 15s
[*]New Special Upgrade [b]Meditate[/b] : Standing still will recover player HP and increasing Damage Reduction.
[*]Temporary removal of Killer Drone due to some bugs
[*]Removed Alchemist Touch
[*]Archer Luster Burst base damage 10 -> 15
[*]Add confirmation menu to Game Over screen
[*]Fix some localization bug
[*]Improve Legendary Chest Reward
[/list]
[h3]Side Notes[/h3]
In the next update we will do some [b]UI rework[/b] to accommodate planned future updates and improve user QoL.

notes.title: Version 0.8.5 - Intergalactic Visitor Update
notes.content:
[i][b]◆  Character  ◆ [/b][/i]
⚔️ Knight 
- Weapon Evo Lv.5 Neos Barrier -> Neo Sword : Long Slash can trigger consecutively with diminishing chance
⛏️ Miner
- New Attack Targeting System, can hit even close enemies
- Now can use Ricochet and Multishot

[b][i]◆ New Character ◆[/i][/b]
🚀 Star Wanderer
- DMG 15
- AS 1/s
- CDMG 50%
- CCH 1%
- MS 2.6
- STM 80
- HP 125
- SA 20%
- Damage Resistance 0%
- Rocket Barrage : Launch Homing Rocket equal to 25% Max Ammo, dealing 5 + ( DMG * 50% SA). CD 10s.

🚀 New Weapon Evo : Star Wanderer
Lvl 1 : +7 Ammo
Lvl 2 : +25% Rocket SA Multiplier (75%)
Lvl 3 : +9 Ammo
Lvl 4 : -20% Rocket CD (8s)
Lvl 5 : Starburst : Standing still charge the weapon up to 4s. +2 Pierce/s and Deal DMG up to 600%. Release huge laser on max charge. -50% uncharged DMG.
Lvl 6-8 : Charge & Uncharged DMG +10/15/25% (Uncharged 60/75/100%) (Charged 610/625/650%)
Lvl 9 : +25% Rocket SA Multiplier (100%)
Lvl 10 : -30% Rocket CD (5s)


[i][b]◆ Special Upgrades ◆[/b][/i]
New Special Upgrade 
- Rare - Reload Shield : When Reloading Create Barrier equal to 5 + 5% HP for Reload Duration + 0.5s.
- Rare - Rebuke : After taking damage next 3 attack will be Critical with +200% CDMG.
- Epic - Stamina Boost : Increase MS equal to 50% STM percentage.
- Legendary - Stellar Shield : Create barrier with 5 charge. Each charge can block 1 instance of damage and +20% SA. When charge depleted explode and deal 50 + (50 * SA/100). CD 30s.
- Unique - Last Stand : When about to die, Fully heal HP and burn 3% HP/s. You can't take damage and heal anymore.
 
[i][b]◆ New Stage ◆[/b][/i]
Snowdrift Vale

💀 Enemies
- Fang Bunny : Melee
- Kobold : Ranged - Charging
- Bomber : Charging - AoE
- Warewolf : Melee - Tanky


💀 Mini Boss
- Ice Mage : Ranged - Unique Ability
- Hive Bomber : Summoner - Ranged
- Serpent : Summoner - AoE - Unique Ability
- Lycan : Melee - Charging - AoE

💀 Boss
 Hydra : ???

- Minotaur : New Skill Set Added
- Fix Tilemap Edge Glitch
- Rework Enemy Code & Structure
- Fix Crowd Control System
- Remove Few Special Upgrades (A B C D)
- Improve Enemies Animation, Bullets, Glowing Material
- Improve SFX
- Nerf Stage Difficulty ( Hard and Above )
- Redistribute Soul Point Calculation
- Buff Revive Chance on Multiplayer

notes.title: Dev Update: Game Release
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we from [b]KatrGames[/b] are excited to announce that [b]Tiny Chaos[/b] will be releasing within this week on 28th March 2024 and we will be giving [b]20% special discount[/b] on the first week of the release.
Also we also will be taking down the demo that has been there since the Steam Next Fest, we sincerly thankful for everyone that has downloaded, played, and wishlisted our game!

Now we will talk about what's new for the [b]released version[/b]
First, as per our last announcement we are adding [b]Localization[/b] for Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, Germany, and Bahasa Indonesia.
Next, we are adding [b]Stage 2[/b] with the new enemies, mini boss, and of course a new boss monster!
not forgeting the new unlockable character that can be obtained by conquering Hard difficulty.
Then we also add more [b]QoL update[/b], now you can check the taken upgrades from the database that located on the middle of the pause menu, lastly there will be more indicators and more sfx for that is still missing.

Since we are trying new stuff on Stage 2 we would like to ask for your opinion after experiencing the gameplay yourself, feel free to talk to us and discuss stuff!

We will be back again soon to announce more stuff so stay tune and thank you for the support!

notes.title: Localization is on the way
notes.content:
We are planning to support some other languages listed below
- Simplified Chinese
- Russian
- Germany
- Japanese
- Korean
- Indonesian
- Portuguese
- Spanish

As we are using machine learning translation to translate it back and forth from and into English
there will be some wording that will feels weird for the native speaker of that language.

So if anyone willing to help fixing the translation please join our Discord.
Just talk about it in public chat to get me notified and give the role for google spread sheet access.

[url=https://discord.gg/KRADGAwmu5][img]https://i.imgur.com/NrMqAza.png[/img][/url]
